meta.title: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments - impairment (5.5 and B5.5): staging, significant increase in credit risk, 12-month and lifetime expected credit losses, forward-looking information, write-off
meta.basis: As of 14 October 2026: the code at commit abe140d and the fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 of 13 October 2026 (made before commit 216aee2, so its discounting and Mega Farm figures predate those changes), read with SELECTs only; the Governance Centre's staging and forward-looking settings; the PHPUnit suite as written (not run for this audit). Main book at September 2026 on that bootstrap: 134 loans, gross 23.19bn, ECL 11.57bn undiscounted, 7.12bn discounted on the 62 loans the time-phased engine resolved (72 unresolved).
meta.source: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments as issued by the IASB, section 5.5 and B5.5.1 to B5.5.55; 5.4.4 and B5.4.9 (write-off). The Reserve Bank of Malawi Financial Services (Credit Risk Management for Development Finance Institutions) Directive 2018 (docs/regulatory). Specification: docs/MAIIC_EIR_Engine_Specification_v4_2026-10-07.md sections 3.6, 13, 14, 15, 16.

rows.section_name: A loss allowance for expected credit losses
rows.requirement: Recognise a loss allowance for expected credit losses on a financial asset measured at amortised cost.
rows.engine_comment: ifrs9:segment-ecl computes the allowance per loan as EAD x PD x LGD on the post-FLI PD for every portfolio of a month and fails closed, naming the loans, when a stage, PD or LGD is missing or a portfolio mixes Mega Farm with MAIIC's own loans; the bootstrap and the month-end (fli:month-end) run it for every period. On the fresh bootstrap the main book carries an allowance in every month (11.57bn undiscounted at September 2026).
rows.general_comment: Fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 (13 October 2026, before commit 216aee2). Until 14 October 2026 the row said the PD engine must run for a figure.
rows.compliance_comment: Compliant; the figures are system figures under the bootstrap label, not MAIIC-approved (finding F1).

rows.section_name: Lifetime ECL on a significant increase in credit risk
rows.requirement: At each reporting date, measure the loss allowance at lifetime ECL if the credit risk has increased significantly since initial recognition.
rows.engine_comment: StagingService stages every period: Stage 2 from 31 days past due in every class, the SICR flag from the qualitative groups; the ECL takes the lifetime PD for Stage 2, compounding beyond the 12-month PD. Since 216aee2 the days past due read E-Banker's instalment chart in force at each month-end.
rows.where_to_see: Settings, Staging basis: /setting?tab=staging; IFRS 9 Model Setup, Staging & SICR Rules: /sicr-groups; ECL Processing, ECL Calculation: /expected-credit-loss/list

rows.section_name: 12-month ECL where credit risk has not increased significantly
rows.requirement: Measure the loss allowance at 12-month ECL where the credit risk has not increased significantly since initial recognition.
rows.engine_comment: Stage 1 loans take the 12-month PD window; the staging writes the stage every period.

rows.section_name: Determining a significant increase in credit risk; the 30-days-past-due rebuttable presumption
rows.requirement: Assess the change in the risk of default since initial recognition using reasonable and supportable information; there is a rebuttable presumption that credit risk has increased significantly when payments are more than 30 days past due.
rows.engine_comment: Stage 2 from 31 days past due in every facility class, counted from the oldest overdue instalment, with the bucket ageing beside it. The rebuttal is recorded on the threshold rows (staging_thresholds.rebuttal_basis); the LONG_TERM row proposing Stage 2 at 91 days for medium- and long-term facilities only is seeded future-dated (2099) and inactive pending CFO sign-off. Since 14 October 2026 a threshold row is proposed by one person and approved by another on Settings, Staging basis, forward only and never into a locked month, and staging reads only approved rows, at the period end, with no 31/181 fallback in the legacy importer (audit H11). The staging_rebuttal catalogue setting is marked recorded, not yet applied: the rebuttal is the threshold row with its evidence.
rows.general_comment: The O13 rebuttal paper of 8 October 2026. Until 14 October 2026 the threshold rows were seeded and read-only on screen.
rows.compliance_comment: Compliant; the presumption is applied and the rebuttal awaits the CFO.
rows.where_to_see: Settings, Staging basis: /setting?tab=staging; IFRS 9 Model Setup, Staging & SICR Rules: /sicr-groups; Governance: Governance Centre /eir-governance

rows.section_name: Definition of default; the 90-days-past-due rebuttable presumption
rows.requirement: Apply a definition of default consistent with internal credit risk management; default occurs no later than 90 days past due unless reasonable and supportable information supports a more lagging criterion.
rows.engine_comment: Stage 3 from 91 days for a facility of 12 months or less and for the Mega Farm class, and from 181 days for a medium- or long-term facility, as the RBM directive classifies them; the four-consecutive-missed-instalments trigger lifts a loan to Stage 3 beside the day count, reading the chart in force and net cash (216aee2). The more lagging criterion rests on the directive, cited on each threshold row.
rows.general_comment: Spec v4 section 3.6 compares the policy (90 days), the November 2025 model (181) and the directive (181/91).
rows.compliance_comment: Compliant; the rebuttal is documented on the threshold rows.
rows.where_to_see: Settings, Staging basis: /setting?tab=staging; IFRS 9 Model Setup, Staging & SICR Rules: /sicr-groups

rows.requirement: ECL is an unbiased, probability-weighted amount determined by evaluating a range of possible outcomes, the time value of money, and reasonable and supportable information about past events, current conditions and forecasts.
rows.engine_comment: The PD and LGD by segment, the forward-looking route once per scenario and the weighted ECL run for every period; discounting at the EIR is the month-end default since 216aee2. What is missing: no fit is approved by a MAIIC reviewer, so the route holds the PD (overlay at zero); the governed scenario set is approved only under the bootstrap label; the legacy synthetic scenario assumptions are still seeded APPROVED (EclScenarioAssumptionSeeder); and the reports read the undiscounted ecl_value (5.5.17(b) row).
rows.general_comment: Fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 (13 October 2026, before commit 216aee2). Until 14 October 2026 the row said the PD engine had not run on the clean install.
rows.compliance_comment: Partially done: the mechanics are in place; an approved fit and set, and the discounted figure in the reports, are awaited.
rows.where_to_see: ECL Processing, ECL Calculation: /expected-credit-loss/list; Forward-Looking Information, Scenario Sets: /scenario-sets

rows.requirement: The estimate reflects the possibility that a credit loss occurs and the possibility that none occurs; a range of scenarios, at least two, weighted by their probabilities.
rows.engine_comment: The governed scenario set: three or more scenarios, weights summing to 100, the base at least 40 percent and no weight above 60, every scenario but the base a shock on the base path; the first set (Base 50, Upside 15, Downside 25, Severe 10) is seeded as a proposal for the CFO. On the fresh bootstrap one set (September 2026) is APPROVED under the bootstrap label.
rows.general_comment: Fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 (13 October 2026, before commit 216aee2).

rows.section_name: Reasonable and supportable information; forward-looking information
rows.requirement: Use information reasonably available without undue cost or effort, including forecasts of future economic conditions; a statistical relationship used must be supportable.
rows.engine_comment: Malawi macro series with their provenance (13 variables, 261 data points on the fresh bootstrap; none yet carries a release date, so revisions replace the earlier value); the correlation finder sweeps every driver against every credit-loss proxy over the lag grid under the guardrail (expected sign, R2 cutoff, p-value, minimum observations) and declines a failing fit with the reason. On the fresh bootstrap: 209 fits, 32 applied by the guardrail, 177 declined, none approved.
rows.general_comment: Fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 (13 October 2026, before commit 216aee2). Until 14 October 2026 the row said 39 applied and 170 declined, from the 8 October install.
rows.compliance_comment: Compliant; an applied fit is a proposal under maker-checker.
rows.where_to_see: Forward-Looking Information: Overview /fli; Correlation Finder /fli-correlation; Regression /fli-adjustments; transmission methods /fli/transmission-methods; Macro Statistics: /macro-statistics

rows.section_name: How forward-looking information reaches the PD
rows.requirement: The method of adjusting the PD for the forecast must be documented and supportable.
rows.engine_comment: Governed transmission methods, each with a card (what it does, the formula, its preconditions checked live against the data, a worked example on one loan); a method whose preconditions are not met cannot be selected; the scalar is seeded because the history cannot yet support the richer methods.
rows.where_to_see: Forward-Looking Information: Overview /fli; Correlation Finder /fli-correlation; Regression /fli-adjustments; transmission methods /fli/transmission-methods; Governance: Governance Centre /eir-governance

rows.requirement: Where information is not available at the instrument level, assess on a collective basis grouped by shared credit-risk characteristics.
rows.engine_comment: PdSegmentationService and LgdSegmentationService measure the PD and LGD per portfolio on the governed basis, a thin segment taking its parent's or the pooled figure under the governed rule, with the lineage on each loan; the Mega Farm programme is its own segment, kept out of MAIIC's PD, LGD and ECL, and a portfolio mixing the two is refused (216aee2). Both run for every period in the bootstrap and the month-end.
rows.general_comment: Until 14 October 2026 this row was Partially done and said the transition matrices were not in the bootstrap chain.
rows.where_to_see: IFRS 9 Model Setup, PD Model and LGD Model; Reports: PD by portfolio /ifrs9-reports/sector-ecl

rows.requirement: The cash shortfalls reflect the cash flows expected from collateral and other credit enhancements that are integral to the contractual terms.
rows.engine_comment: The LGD is the Stage 3 cohort workout per portfolio (cure, recovery discounted, write-off as loss; a written-off loan left at nil is no longer a cure since 216aee2). Collateral does not enter it: the engine reads no collateral, and on the fresh bootstrap collateral_registers and collateral_allocations are empty although the E-Banker security register (P2_11, 185 rows) is landed.
rows.general_comment: Until 14 October 2026 this row was referenced B5.5.33 to B5.5.35 and marked Evidence needed; the collateral link is also Dupleix's to build.
rows.compliance_comment: Partially done: Credit supplies the collateral and valuations; Dupleix brings collateral into the LGD.
rows.where_to_see: IFRS 9 Model Setup, LGD Model; Collateral Management, Collateral Register: /collateral/register; Reports: LGD and collateral /ifrs9-reports/lgd-collateral

rows.requirement: Discount the expected credit losses at the EIR determined at initial recognition (or an approximation).
rows.engine_comment: TimePhasedEclService discounts each loan's expected shortfalls at its locked original EIR and a floating-rate loan's at its current EIR for the month (EIR_CURRENT_FLOATING: the rate the revenue run accrued at, or the same D38 re-estimation from the rate charged; B5.5.44); an unlocked or missing EIR, or a floating loan with no current EIR, is unresolved with the reason, never defaulted or given the original rate; a Stage 3 loss at the reporting date needs no rate. Since 14 October 2026 EclDiscountRateService (the LGD recovery discounting) applies the same rule, so no basis is labelled EIR_ORIGINAL_FLOATING_PROXY any more. Since 216aee2 the month-end and the bootstrap run discounted by default: ecl_value keeps the engine's measure and ecl_value_discounted holds the discounted allowance, shown on the ECL screen. Since 14 October 2026 every report carries the booked allowance (BookedEcl: discounted at the original EIR; the Mega Farm programme measure; a loan with no discounted figure at its undiscounted ECL, counted and named), with the reconciliation from the reporting-date measure (the lifetime projection and the effect of discounting); the IFRS 9 note fails closed while any loan lacks its discounted allowance. On the fresh bootstrap at September 2026, 62 main-book loans are discounted (7,118,643,553.12) and 38 with an ECL have no discounted figure (4,460,558,036.40 undiscounted; most without a locked EIR).
rows.general_comment: Fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 (13 October 2026, before commit 216aee2). Until 14 October 2026 the row said 'the contractual rate where none is locked', which the code never did; and the reports read the undiscounted ecl_value.
rows.compliance_comment: Partially done: the reports carry the discounted allowance; 38 loans still need a locked EIR before the allowance is wholly discounted.

rows.requirement: Write off the gross carrying amount when there is no reasonable expectation of recovery.
rows.engine_comment: WriteOffClassifier (220a5a6) identifies ledger write-offs (type 300; a batch debiting GL 1064; ACCOUNT CLOSURE on a status-H account) for the loan-book build, the contract inputs and the EIR cash; the PD cohort counts a write-off as a default (216aee2); the register records a write-off not on the loan account under two-person approval; since 14 October 2026 the same source (WriteOffSource) feeds the IFRS 9 note, the reconciliations and the RBM Return, and the monthly feed M09_01 is read for write-off batch legs. On the fresh bootstrap: 22 ledger write-offs of 60,778,466.86 (20 of them, 38,492,032.54, between December 2025 and September 2026); the register is empty.
rows.general_comment: Fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 (13 October 2026, before commit 216aee2). Until 14 October 2026 the row said no write-off had been posted since the take-on.
rows.compliance_comment: Evidence needed: MAIIC's write-off policy and Finance's confirmation of status H.

rows.section_name: The Mega Farm loans in the allowance
rows.requirement: Loans extended under the Government's Mega Farm programme (losses to the fund; MAIIC's 5 percent share) must be in the ECL on a documented basis.
rows.engine_comment: The programme's monthly books (MF_01 and MF_03) are landed: on the fresh bootstrap 3,692 loans on six of the programme's seven GLs (1050301 to 1050305 and 1050307) with 56.18bn gross at September 2026, 3,559 of them over 90 days past due. Since 216aee2 the programme is segmented as its own portfolio, kept out of MAIIC's PD, LGD and ECL, and provided by megafarm:ecl from its own LGD cohort under the governed PD method; MAIIC's share is read from the mega_farms_scope text (it falls back to 1.0 when the text names no share). Not built: the interest split, the maize receivable and the fund liability of spec 16.4 and 16.5 (they wait on D30).
rows.general_comment: Fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 (13 October 2026, before commit 216aee2). Until 14 October 2026 the row said 3,490 loans (K54.85bn) from a November 2025 book.
rows.compliance_comment: Evidence needed: the CFO's confirmation of D30; how the K39.76bn provision of 2025 was arrived at.
rows.where_to_see: ECL Processing, Mega Farm Programme: /megafarm; Governance: Governance Centre /eir-governance

findings.finding: The PD, LGD and ECL are the bootstrap's, not MAIIC's
findings.what_was_found: The PD and LGD engines run under the bootstrap label; no MAIIC reviewer has approved a segment run, a fit or the scenario set. On the fresh bootstrap the main-book ECL at September 2026 is 11.57bn undiscounted (7.12bn discounted on 62 loans, 72 unresolved). (Until 14 October 2026 this finding quoted 8.33bn, which the Contract Schedule 1 workbook gave as 8.94bn; neither is current.)
findings.impact: The ECL is a system figure awaiting review.
findings.recommended_action: A reviewer approves the segment runs, a fit and the set; the month is re-run discounted and signed.

findings.finding: No fit is approved by a MAIIC reviewer
findings.what_was_found: On the fresh bootstrap the guardrail applied 32 of 209 fits and declined 177; none is approved for the route.
findings.impact: The forward-looking adjustment is the overlay at zero until then.
findings.recommended_action: A reviewer approves a fit on the Regression (FLI adjustments) screen; a second person reviews.

findings.finding: The Mega Farm provision basis is undocumented
findings.what_was_found: The 2025 statements carry K39.76bn against K48.7bn Stage 3. On the fresh bootstrap (staging before 216aee2) the December 2025 programme book of 3,692 loans (54.50bn) is 3,219 loans Stage 1 (47.25bn) and 471 Stage 3 (7.25bn).
findings.impact: The ECL golden number at 31 December 2025 cannot be set.
findings.recommended_action: The CFO confirms D30 and the provisioning method; the next bootstrap on 216aee2 restages the programme on the chart in force.

findings.finding: The reports carry the undiscounted allowance
findings.what_was_found: The discounted allowance is held in ecl_value_discounted; the IFRS 9 note, ECL reconciliation, RBM Return and other reports read ecl_value. Status 14 October 2026: the reports carry the booked allowance with the undiscounted measure as a reconciling line, and name the loans with no discounted figure (38 at September 2026); the note fails closed until there are none.
findings.impact: The disclosed allowance is not wholly discounted until those loans carry a locked EIR.
findings.recommended_action: Lock the EIRs of the named loans (fee reviews), then run the month-end ECL again.

findings.finding: Collateral is not in the LGD
findings.what_was_found: The LGD engine reads no collateral; the collateral register is empty on the fresh bootstrap.
findings.impact: The cash flows from collateral are not reflected in the shortfall.
findings.recommended_action: Credit supplies the collateral and valuations; Dupleix adds the collateral recovery to the LGD.
